name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.KSplit.mix_leak
title: Two BGG+-style encodings of different attributes on one matrix and one secret reveal a multiple of s^T G
statement: Over a commutative ring, (s A - x s G + e) - (s A - x' s G + e') = (x' - x) s G + (e - e'): publishing both attribute values of one encoded block under one secret leaks a noisy multiple of s^T G, so the secret is decodable when x' - x is a unit.
